as_told.title: Puharich meditates in the King's Chamber

plain: This story is about audio recordings of a researcher named Andrija Puharich meditating inside the King's Chamber, the main stone room deep inside the Great Pyramid in Egypt. A researcher named Greg Malatzi, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that he and others have these tapes. A second guest on the same episode repeats the claim and dates the recordings to 1976, to the host's surprise. The guests cite the tapes themselves as the source. It matters to them because, if real, the recordings would capture firsthand Puharich's efforts to reach some unseen intelligence at one of the world's most famous ancient sites.
